statement: The live Elite Series 2 Bluetooth HID descriptor, report timing, paddle/profile behavior and binding to hid-microsoft versus xpadneo remain unmeasured here. No Bluetooth-bus UHID instance has been shown to satisfy HID parsing, output and feature replies or SDL/xpadneo acceptance, and UHID alone cannot establish over-the-air discoverability or pairing.

applicability.revision: Xbox Elite Series 2 model 1797, software-side revision at pinned sources
applicability.scope: Device and host-acceptance gaps for Elite models 0x0b05 and 0x0b22, including selected firmware revisions. Keep radio transport separate from host-local UHID.
